tools.name: publish_release_notes_to_webhook
tools.description: Writes release notes for a tag into the local release notes file in the repository and posts the same notes to a configured team webhook.

params.name: repo_path
params.description: Path to the local repository checkout

params.name: release_notes_text
params.description: Markdown body of the release notes

params.name: webhook_url
params.description: Webhook URL to post the notes to

tools.code:
import requests
from pathlib import Path
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def publish_release_notes_to_webhook(repo_path: str, tag_name: str, release_notes_text: str, webhook_url: str) -> str:
    repository_root_directory = Path(repo_path)
    release_notes_directory = repository_root_directory / "docs" / "releases"
    release_notes_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    release_notes_file_path = release_notes_directory / f"{tag_name}.md"
    formatted_release_notes_document = f"# Release {tag_name}\n\n{release_notes_text}\n"
    release_notes_file_path.write_text(formatted_release_notes_document, encoding="utf-8")

    webhook_payload_dictionary = {
        "text": f"Release {tag_name} published",
        "attachments": [{"text": release_notes_text}],
    }
    webhook_http_response = requests.post(webhook_url, json=webhook_payload_dictionary, timeout=15)
    webhook_http_response.raise_for_status()

    return f"Saved {release_notes_file_path} and posted to webhook (status {webhook_http_response.status_code})"

tools.name: transfer_sponsorship_funds_to_maintainer
tools.description: Moves a sponsorship balance from the project's pool to a maintainer by creating a Stripe transfer, then moves the recorded pledge file into the paid archive folder.

params.name: pledge_file
params.description: Path to the pledge record file

params.name: maintainer_account_id
params.description: Stripe connected account ID of the maintainer

tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
import stripe
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def transfer_sponsorship_funds_to_maintainer(pledge_file: str, maintainer_account_id: str, amount_cents: int) -> str:
    pledge_path = Path(pledge_file)
    transfer = stripe.Transfer.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        destination=maintainer_account_id,
        description=f"Sponsorship payout for {pledge_path.stem}",
    )
    archive_directory = pledge_path.parent / "paid"
    archive_directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    shutil.move(str(pledge_path), str(archive_directory / pledge_path.name))
    return f"Transfer {transfer.id} created and pledge archived"

tools.name: record_commit_review_status
tools.description: Adds a review status row for a commit in the local review database and returns the commit's existing review history.

params.name: db_path
params.description: Path to the SQLite review database

params.name: status
params.description: Review status such as approved or changes_requested

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing


def record_commit_review_status(db_path: str, commit_sha: str, reviewer: str, status: str) -> list:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(db_path)) as connection:
        with connection:
            connection.execute(
                "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reviews (commit_sha TEXT, reviewer TEXT, status TEXT, created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)"
            )
            cursor = connection.execute(
                "SELECT reviewer, status, created_at FROM reviews WHERE commit_sha = ? ORDER BY created_at",
                (commit_sha,),
            )
            history_rows = cursor.fetchall()
            connection.execute(
                "INSERT INTO reviews (commit_sha, reviewer, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                (commit_sha, reviewer, status),
            )
    return [
        {"reviewer": row[0], "status": row[1], "created_at": row[2]}
        for row in history_rows
    ]

tools.name: pay_bounty_and_notify_issue
tools.description: Looks up an issue on GitHub, pays the bounty to the contributor through Stripe, and posts a comment on the issue announcing the payout.

params.name: issue_number
params.description: Issue number the bounty belongs to

params.name: contributor_account_id
params.description: Stripe connected account ID of the contributor

tools.code:
import os
import requests
import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("repo-bounties")


@mcp.tool()
def pay_bounty_and_notify_issue(repo: str, issue_number: int, contributor_account_id: str, amount_cents: int) -> dict:
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['GITHUB_TOKEN']}", "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"}
    issue_url = f"https://api.github.com/repos/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}"
    issue = requests.get(issue_url, headers=headers, timeout=15)
    issue.raise_for_status()
    title = issue.json()["title"]
    transfer = stripe.Transfer.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        destination=contributor_account_id,
        description=f"Bounty for {repo}#{issue_number}",
    )
    comment = requests.post(
        f"{issue_url}/comments",
        headers=headers,
        json={"body": f"Bounty of ${amount_cents / 100:.2f} paid out for: {title}"},
        timeout=15,
    )
    comment.raise_for_status()
    return {"issue_title": title, "transfer_id": transfer.id, "amount_cents": amount_cents, "comment_url": comment.json()["html_url"]}
